title: Fare-Basis Shares for Held-Out Amounts, Wayfare Rides
content:
In the held-out amount of an unpaid-fare payment on **Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares)**, the fare-basis share follows how the fare charge was set, as the fare basis recorded on the fare charge shows.

| Fare basis recorded on the fare charge | Fare-basis share |
|---|---|
| recalculated | 1.0 (recalculated share) |
| minimum fare | 0.7 (minimum-fare share) |
| upfront | not changed |

A recalculated fare takes the recalculated share of 1.0; a fare set at the minimum fare takes the minimum-fare share of 0.7; an upfront fare keeps the share unchanged.

Example (hypothetical): two unpaid fares with the same submitted fare review behind them — one recalculated, one set at the minimum fare — take shares of 1.0 and 0.7 respectively.
